statements.statement: For the HMMWV (M998-series), the thermostat fully opens at approximately 180°F (82°C).

statements.reason: The context gives fan activation as 215°F (102°C), not around 200°F (93°C).
statements.statement: For the HMMWV (M998-series), the fan activation temperature is typically around 200°F (93°C).

statements.statement: As coolant warms in the HMMWV (M998-series), the thermostat fully-open temperature of approximately 180°F (82°C) is reached before the fan-activation temperature of around 200°F (93°C).
